messages:
Maria (CSM): quick weekly health ping: Aurelia's hosted spend jumped friday 22:48 UTC. flagged by the weekly monitors. can we get a root-cause and decide credit vs. bill?
cost-bot: ALERT: hosted_usage_anomaly | org=aurelia | 2026-03-20T22:48Z | tokens=2,800,000 (baseline=750k) | severity=high | dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/aurelia/usage
Sam (Billing): looking now. their monthly commit=30M, typical weekly ~6.5M. this incident would push projection to ~34M if it persists. exporting request-level CSV: https://redwood.app/exports/aurelia/2332468000.csv
Jae (Infra): checked infra logs for retry storms/backfills; nothing abnormal. recent requests show a sudden uptick in long sequence generations. query I ran: `SELECT seq_len_bucket, count(*) FROM requests WHERE org='aurelia' AND ts >= '2026-03-20T22:30Z' GROUP BY seq_len_bucket;` buckets skewed to >1500 tokens.
Leo (Aurelia): hi team, we inadvertently kicked off a QA batch that uses hosted endpoint in parallel (script intended to use our dedicated cluster). stopped at 22:54. sorry about the noise.
Maria (CSM): thanks @Leo. so it's customer-triggered. main questions: (A) one-off credit? (B) guidance to prevent recurrence? (C) renewal / finance impact?
Priya (Acct Lead): for renewals: this is a risk signal only if finance sees repeat overages. single accidental spikes are usually fine if addressed quickly. recommend: credit + enablement + add billing guardrail.
Sam (Billing): propose: 1) discretionary one-time credit to cover the overshoot tokens for that billing cycle; 2) add a weekly alert to warn on >150% of weekly baseline before continuing; 3) document routing guidance.
DocsBot: new doc created: https://redwood.app/docs/routing-dedicated — recommends `X-Route-Preference` header and SDK flags.
Priya (Acct Lead): +1. also ask customer to confirm the job config and whether they can route to dedicated moving forward.
Leo (Aurelia): we'll share the job config in the enablement session. can you also confirm the credit process timeline?
Sam (Billing): I can draft a credit memo today and apply it within 3 business days. will cc @Maria for approval.
Jae (Infra): small ops follow-up: I'll file INF-4932 to add an org-level metric for sudden seq_len shift and an automated pre-billing pause alert at 2x baseline.
Maria (CSM): schedule enablement: 30m session Monday 10:00 PT to show routing, SDK option, and cost guards. action items: Sam -> credit memo; Jae -> INF-4932 ticket; Priya -> renewal note in account doc; Leo -> job config & confirm routing change.
Leo (Aurelia): thanks team, appreciate the fast response.
Maria (CSM): closing thread, will update weekly health doc and mark as low-to-medium renewal risk after credit + enablement. :white_check_mark:
